meta.index.title: Your chats in your AI tools, on your own computer
meta.index.description: Connect your Telegram account to Claude, Codex and other MCP clients. It runs on your computer, starts read-only and shows a preview before anything is sent.
meta.download.title: Download
meta.download.description: Installers for macOS, Windows and Linux, command-line binaries and SHA-256 checksums to verify every file.
meta.headless.title: Headless server
meta.headless.description: Run the daemon on a Linux machine you control, as a user service bound to 127.0.0.1 and guarded by a token. Remote access only through an SSH tunnel or a private network.

dl.note.macos: A single app that runs on both Intel and Apple silicon processors.
dl.note.linux: The AppImage runs on most distributions; the .deb is for Ubuntu, Debian and their derivatives. Pick your computer's architecture.
dl.note.cli: Just the telegram-mcp binary, no window. For servers and for people who prefer the terminal.
